cases.issue: Receipt totals are too low when one line contains multiple units. Single-unit purchases look fine.
cases.rationale: The existing receipt fixture has a direct arithmetic defect and an unrelated inventory helper.
cases.diagnosis: The total sums the price of one unit per line, ignoring each line's quantity.
cases.fix: Multiply unit price by quantity before summing the lines.
cases.regression: Two units at 250 cents and one at 100 cents should total 600 cents.

cases.issue: Checkout charges $4.99 for shipping on an order of exactly $50 even though the store advertises free shipping starting at $50.
cases.rationale: The checkout wrapper and tariff implementation are both needed to explain the observed checkout behavior.
cases.diagnosis: Checkout delegates to the standard tariff, whose strict comparison excludes a subtotal of exactly 5000 cents.
cases.fix: Make the free-shipping threshold inclusive in the tariff.
cases.regression: Check 4999, 5000, and 5001 cents, expecting 499, 0, and 0 respectively.

cases.issue: Dispatch rejects a loading slot when the requested parcel count exactly matches the posted slot capacity.
cases.rationale: The exact-fit case probes an inclusive business boundary.
cases.diagnosis: The strict less-than capacity check excludes an exact fit.
cases.fix: Allow requests up to and including the capacity.
cases.regression: Check that 9 and 10 fit a capacity of 10, while 11 does not.

cases.issue: The default storefront catalog shows archived products and hides the current ones. Turning on the option to include archived products shows everything.
cases.rationale: The default and opt-in branches separate the filtering mistake from other catalog behavior.
cases.diagnosis: The default predicate keeps archived products, while the opt-in branch already returns all products.
cases.fix: Keep current products by inverting the default predicate and preserve the opt-in branch.
cases.regression: With both active and archived products, check that default returns only active and opt-in returns both.

cases.issue: After a product price is viewed, an admin price change succeeds but a second view still displays the original price.
cases.rationale: A warmed read followed by a write isolates cache invalidation from initial lookup.
cases.diagnosis: Updating the backing price leaves an existing cached price untouched, so the next read reuses the stale value.
cases.fix: Invalidate or update the cached entry for the SKU on writes.
cases.regression: Read a price, change it, and read again on the same price book, verifying that other SKUs are unaffected.

cases.issue: A request for three products on the second page may return nothing even when enough products remain. The first page works.
cases.rationale: The function name promises count-based pagination, while the implementation treats the limit as an absolute endpoint.
cases.diagnosis: The slice treats the requested count as the stop index instead of adding it to the offset.
cases.fix: Use the offset plus the requested count as the slice stop.
cases.regression: With ten products, offset 3 and limit 3 should return positions 3 through 5, and a final partial page should still work.

cases.issue: The delivery window display shows 200 minutes for a two-hour route. The report was filed against the dashboard view.
cases.rationale: The report names the UI, while the linked conversion in timing owns the arithmetic. Related forecasting functions compete for retrieval.
cases.diagnosis: The dashboard delegates to a converter that multiplies hours by 100 instead of 60.
cases.fix: Convert hours using 60 minutes per hour in the shared helper.
cases.regression: Check that a two-hour route displays 120 minutes and a half hour displays 30.

cases.issue: A printed receipt looks wrong for one order. The reporter has no transaction details, actual total, expected total, or list of purchased items.
cases.rationale: Several outcomes are compatible with the report. The fixture contains a known defect but the report gives no basis for attributing this occurrence to it.

cases.issue: Customers do not receive an SMS when free shipping becomes available after a cart update.
cases.rationale: The fixture has checkout tariff and currency display code. It has no subscriptions, cart event handler, or SMS integration.
